forehead_shine.title: Forehead shine
forehead_shine.body: Your forehead and nose look shiny — a sign of an oily T-zone.
forehead_shine.tip: A light, oil-free moisturizer and a BHA cleanser can help.

under_eye.title: Under-eyes
under_eye.body: The skin under your eyes looks darker than your cheeks.
under_eye.tip: Sleep, daily sunscreen and an eye cream with caffeine or vitamin C may help.

cheek_texture.title: Cheek texture
cheek_texture.body: Your cheeks show some bumps or uneven texture.
cheek_texture.tip: Gentle exfoliation (AHA/BHA) 2–3 times a week can smooth it.

cheek_redness.title: Cheek redness
cheek_redness.body: There are redder patches on your cheeks.
cheek_redness.tip: Calming ingredients like centella or niacinamide help; skip harsh scrubs.

nose_pores.title: Nose pores
nose_pores.body: The pores around your nose look more visible.
nose_pores.tip: Salicylic acid (BHA) or niacinamide helps keep pores clear.

hydration.what: How smooth and supple your skin's surface looks. Dry skin looks rougher and duller.
hydration.tip: Use a hydrating serum (hyaluronic acid) and a moisturizer every day.

elasticity.what: How few fine lines show on your forehead and under your eyes.
elasticity.tip: Daily sunscreen and a gentle retinoid at night help with fine lines.

pigmentation.what: How even your skin tone is — fewer dark spots and marks score higher.
pigmentation.tip: Daily SPF plus vitamin C or niacinamide helps even out tone.

texture.what: How smooth your cheeks look — fewer bumps and rough patches score higher.
texture.tip: Gentle exfoliation (AHA/BHA) 2–3 times a week smooths texture.

pores.what: How visible the pores on your nose are — less visible scores higher.
pores.tip: Salicylic acid (BHA) or niacinamide helps keep pores clear.
